name: Kamp Kairphree
operator_name: Town of Greenwich Parks and Recreation
street_address: Cohen Eastern Greenwich Civic Center, 90 Harding Road
description_short: A town run day camp for ages 5 to 12, 9 am to 4 pm, based at the Cohen Eastern Greenwich Civic Center in Old Greenwich. Campers do arts and crafts, sports and board games, go to Greenwich Point Beach once a week and take the ferry to Island Beach every Wednesday, and free bus stops around town are offered.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds and no prorating. Requests for full credit are considered before June 1, half credit on or after June 1, and credit is prorated once camp begins. Credits carry a $20 administrative fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers spend one day a week at Greenwich Point Beach and Wednesdays at Island Beach (reached by ferry), weather permitting. Bring a bathing suit, towel and water shoes daily.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Kamp Kairphree registration form. Prices are non-resident rates (Session 1 $570, Sessions 2 and 3 $445); residents pay $480 and $375 early bird, $515 and $405 from June 1. Lunch comes from home. Bus transport is included in the fee. The form gives the address as 90 Harding Road, Old Greenwich; city is recorded as Greenwich (the town) because Old Greenwich is not in the city table. No camp July 3.
Researched by Claude from this page. Town camp page; links the registration form and the WebTrac online registration.
